user_story: As a user, I want deleting a non-existent task to return a clear error so that I know the operation failed.

positive.title: Successfully delete an existing task
steps: Create a new task with a known ID.
Call the delete function with the existing task ID.
positive.expected_result: The task is successfully deleted and a success message is returned.

negative.title: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
steps: Call the delete function with a task ID that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating that the task does not exist.

edge.title: Attempt to delete a task with an invalid ID format
steps: Call the delete function with an invalid task ID format (e.g., a string instead of a number).
edge.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating invalid task ID format.
